name: robertkleffner/mariohtml5
embed_notes: Open main.html; no build. Canvas+Audio only.
reskin_notes: All sprites in images/ (mariosheet, enemysheet, mapsheet), sounds in sounds/; sprite cuts defined in code/spriteCuts.js; procedural level generator. Nintendo art must be replaced.
score_hook: Mario.MarioCharacter.coins/lives and LevelState/WinState/LoseState transitions in code/levelState.js - wrap state enter() to postMessage.
notes: Public-domain port of Notch's Infinite Mario; endless procedural levels = ideal arcade loop. FullScreenMario itself is DMCA-blocked (HTTP 451) - this is the usable Mario clone.

name: meth-meth-method/super-mario
embed_notes: public/ is a static site (index.html + ES modules); npm start just serves it. Needs HTTP (module imports).
reskin_notes: Sprite sheets and level layouts are JSON in public/sprites and public/levels (tile/pattern definitions) - very data-driven. Nintendo art must be replaced.
score_hook: Player trait has score/coins/lives; Level events emitted via EventEmitter - easy to hook.
notes: Very clean tutorial codebase (YouTube series); NO LICENSE FILE - flag as unusable until author licenses it.

name: pablogozalvez/Super-Mario-Phaser
games: Super Mario Bros clone with random level generation
embed_notes: index.html + assets/ + javascript/; no build step.
reskin_notes: Sprites/audio in assets/; Phaser texture keys so swapping PNGs is trivial. Nintendo art must be replaced.
score_hook: Score/coins/time text objects in scene; game-over scene - add postMessage in scene transition.
notes: MIT + random level gen + static = easiest Mario-style reskin candidate.

name: JSLegendDev/Mario-Game-Kaboom.js
embed_notes: index.html + libs + assets + content; no bundler required.
reskin_notes: assets/ sprite sheets and sounds; levels as ASCII maps in content/. Nintendo-style art should be replaced.
score_hook: Kaboom scene state (score/lives) - trivial to add go('gameover') hook.
notes: Low stars but MIT, tiny, and built to be modified (tutorial author). Same author has Pokemon-p5js, Kirby-like-ts, sonic-runner, JavaScript-Metroidvania.

name: felixmariotto/Edelweiss
embed_notes: public/ is static; app.js is just an Express static server (Procfile). Serve public/ directly.
reskin_notes: 3D hero model/textures and sceneGraph JSON map; recoloring textures easy, replacing the hero mesh with a mascot is 3D work.
score_hook: Collectible edelweiss count and save state in game logic; no formal score - hook collection events.
notes: CC0 complete 3D platformer that runs on mobile; custom physics; multiplayer mod included.

name: clarkeadg/opensonic-js
embed_notes: webpack build; docs/ folder is a prebuilt GitHub Pages copy that can be iframed directly.
reskin_notes: Sprite sheets and level data in public/; port of Open Sonic (original assets GPL-ish fan art, Sega-derived) - replace characters.
score_hook: Rings/score/lives in player object; level clear state - add hook in level end.
notes: Only working Sonic-physics engine for the web with MIT code; coderman64/motobug-engine is unlicensed.

name: JSLegendDev/sonic-runner
embed_notes: Vite build to static dist/.
reskin_notes: public/graphics + public/sounds; single character sprite sheet - swap for mascot. Sega art must be replaced.
score_hook: score variable in game scene with game-over scene - trivial postMessage.
notes: Small endless-runner loop with score already present; perfect play-to-earn shape.

name: KilledByAPixel/LittleJS
embed_notes: examples/* are plain index.html + script; no build. examples/platformer is a full platformer/shooter with level data.
reskin_notes: Each example uses a single tiles.png sprite sheet; colors via code; ZzFX procedural sounds (no audio assets needed).
score_hook: Engine exposes gameUpdate/gameRender; platformer has score/lives; trivial to postMessage.
notes: MULTI-GAME COLLECTION. Actively maintained engine with a separate LittleJSArcade of jam games; tiny footprint.

name: KilledByAPixel/SpaceHuggers
embed_notes: index.html + a few JS files; zero build.
reskin_notes: Single tiny tiles.png; most visuals procedural/destructible terrain; recolor easy, mascot sprite limited to 8x8 tiles.
score_hook: Global score/level counters in app.js; game over handled in app - easy.
notes: GPL (flag). Polished js13k winner; 4-player co-op.

name: pomle/megamanjs
embed_notes: webpack build; public/ output.
reskin_notes: Levels, sprites and animations defined in XML resource files - data-driven; Capcom art must be replaced.
score_hook: Player health/level complete events on the engine event bus.
notes: NO LICENSE - unusable as-is; still the most complete Mega-Man-style engine in JS.

name: JSLegendDev/JavaScript-Metroidvania
embed_notes: index.html + lib + assets + maps; no build.
reskin_notes: assets/ sprites, Tiled JSON maps in maps/.
score_hook: Player state (health, collectibles); add hook on boss defeat/game-over scene.
notes: Only MIT browser metroidvania found; small but complete.

name: mozilla/BrowserQuest
embed_notes: ARCHIVED/DEPRECATED (2023). Requires node server (ws); client is static but useless without server. Old deps (RequireJS, node 0.x era).
reskin_notes: All sprites are PNG + JSON animation descriptors in client/sprites and client/img; easy to swap.
score_hook: No score; kills/xp/level in Player - hook character.js.
notes: Verified: archived. Use forks instead: Jerenaux/phaserquest (MIT, Phaser) or Kaetram-Open (MPL, README says OSS branch abandoned and project now closed-source).

name: Jerenaux/phaserquest
embed_notes: node server.js + MongoDB; Dockerfile provided; client static.
reskin_notes: Uses BrowserQuest CC-BY-SA sprite atlases in assets/; JSON-driven.
score_hook: Player xp/kills on server; client Game.updateLife/killMonster events.
notes: Cleanest MIT BrowserQuest reproduction; needs hosting but single-player-ish play works.

name: Kaetram/Kaetram-Open
embed_notes: Monorepo (packages/), node server + MongoDB. README: open-source branch not updated for years; Kaetram now closed-source.
reskin_notes: CC-BY-SA BrowserQuest-derived assets; Tiled maps; data-driven items/mobs.
score_hook: Player level/xp/achievements server-side.
notes: Biggest BQ descendant but effectively abandoned as OSS - flag.

name: RSamaium/RPG-JS
embed_notes: Vite build; can run pure client (single-player) or with node server (MMORPG) from the same code.
reskin_notes: Spritesheets, Tiled maps, GUI declared in config/decorators; designed for content swapping.
score_hook: Server/player hooks (onLevelUp, onDead, variables) - explicit API for events.
notes: MULTI-GAME (framework + samples). Best-maintained RPG toolkit for the web; bring your own game content.

name: munificent/hauberk
embed_notes: Requires Dart SDK to compile to JS; web/ output is then fully static.
reskin_notes: ASCII/glyph tiles rendered from font PNGs; monsters/items defined in Dart data files; colors via palette - text/name swaps easy, art minimal.
score_hook: Hero level/gold/depth; death handled in game engine - hook Game.result.
notes: Author explicitly invites forks; deep, polished roguelike.

name: Larkenx/Rotten-Soup
embed_notes: vue-cli build to static; server.js is only a static host.
reskin_notes: Tiled maps + tileset PNGs in public/; entity definitions in JS.
score_hook: Player death/floor depth in game store - hook Game.gameOver.
notes: GPL flag. Graphical roguelike with quests, still maintained.

name: ASteinheiser/react-rpg.com
embed_notes: Vite build to static; PWA.
reskin_notes: Tile/sprite PNGs under src/ config; maps as JSON; text in constants - easy.
score_hook: Redux store holds gold/level/floor; Endless mode already has a score & game-over dialog - subscribe to store and postMessage.
notes: MIT, active, has an Endless (score) mode and save/load - strong RPG-lite pick.

name: redpangilinan/dungeon-crawler-rpg-od
games: Dungeon Crawler On Demand (Diablo-style loot crawler)
embed_notes: index.html + assets/js; no build. Repo archived; active AGPL fork Werkstattl/quick-dungeon-crawler-rpg-od (32 stars, pushed 2026-08-25).
reskin_notes: Sprites/sfx/bgm in assets/; UI via CSS; enemy/item names in JS tables.
score_hook: Floor/kills/level stored in localStorage player object; death event in JS - easy.
notes: GPL flag. Idle-ish loot crawler; very embeddable.

name: chr15m/rogule.com
embed_notes: shadow-cljs build to static; optional server for sharing.
reskin_notes: Entire art set is emoji - swap glyphs/emoji + CSS; text in cljs.
score_hook: Daily score + share string already computed on game end.
notes: AGPL flag. Wordle-style daily dungeon with built-in scoring - great retention loop.

name: liyupi/binding-of-isaac-webgame
games: Isaac-style top-down roguelike (12 floors, 13 bosses, 55 items)
embed_notes: index.html + js/ + css; zero build, zero deps.
reskin_notes: All art drawn procedurally in Canvas 2D code - recolor easy, mascot needs code drawing or swapping draw calls for sprites.
score_hook: Floor/boss/item counters in game state; game-over screen in js - easy.
notes: Low stars but MIT, recent, complete roguelike with zero dependencies (Chinese UI text).

name: FullScreenShenanigans/FullScreenPokemon
embed_notes: yarn + webpack; exports createFspInterface(el) for embedding in your own page.
reskin_notes: Sprites are run-length-encoded strings in TS (EightBittr PixelRendr) - replacing art is unusual but tooling exists; text/maps are data.
score_hook: window.FSP instance exposes game state (badges, party, money) - hook via API.
notes: Sibling FullScreenMario is DMCA-blocked (451); this one survives but Nintendo assets must be replaced.

name: pagefaultgames/pokerogue
embed_notes: Vite build; runs offline single-player, optional API server for accounts/saves.
reskin_notes: Thousands of Pokemon sprites (assets submodule, non-commercial/unlicensed) - full replacement impractical; UI/text localized JSON is easy.
score_hook: Wave/score/stat tracking in game data (session data, achievements) - hookable.
notes: Hugely popular but AGPL + NC assets + Nintendo IP: flag as high-risk.

name: keldaanCommunity/pokemonAutoChess
embed_notes: Node/Colyseus + MongoDB; Docker compose provided.
reskin_notes: Pokemon sprite sheets (Nintendo) throughout; data-driven units but asset replacement is huge.
score_hook: Elo/rank/placement on server; game end event in room.
notes: GPL + Nintendo assets + server: flag. Best-maintained auto-battler codebase though.

name: Jameskmonger/creature-chess
embed_notes: Docker compose; node game server + React client.
reskin_notes: Original creature art in modules; unit definitions in data files.
score_hook: Match placement/ELO in server; client receives game-over phase.
notes: AGPL flag. Original-IP auto chess, still maintained.

name: JSLegendDev/Pokemon-p5js
embed_notes: index.html + main.js + assets + maps; no build.
reskin_notes: assets/ sprite PNGs and Tiled maps; small.
score_hook: Battle scene win/lose - trivial hook.
notes: MIT starter for a Pokemon-like; chriscourses/pokemon-style-game (506 stars) is similar but has NO LICENSE.

name: scottlininger/zelda30tribute
games: Zelda 30 Year Tribute (3D voxel Zelda overworld)
embed_notes: www/ is static; archived repo.
reskin_notes: Voxel models built from NES tiles, Nintendo music - must be replaced; overworld data-driven.
score_hook: Rupees/hearts in game state; no game-over economy - weak.
notes: Archived after Nintendo pressure; code MIT.

name: jjppof/goldensun_html5
embed_notes: webpack build; static output; electron wrapper optional.
reskin_notes: Extremely data-driven (JSON for maps, djinn, abilities, dialogs) but assets are Camelot/Nintendo rips - full replacement is a big job.
score_hook: Battle result/party state in engine - hookable.
notes: Most complete open JRPG battle/overworld engine in JS; IP-risky assets.

name: damian-pastorini/reldens
embed_notes: node server.js + MySQL/SQLite; theme/ folder holds client assets; admin panel.
reskin_notes: theme/ directory is the reskin layer (sprites, CSS, config); DB-driven content.
score_hook: Player stats/level on server; client events via Colyseus room messages.
notes: Actively maintained MIT MMORPG platform; needs hosting.

name: oskarrough/slaytheweb
embed_notes: Astro static build; deploys on Cloudflare Pages; single-player, no server needed.
reskin_notes: Cards/powers/monsters are plain JS data in src/content; visuals mostly CSS + a few images (game-icons.net).
score_hook: Run tracking + online leaderboard (run score) already implemented - reuse for postMessage.
notes: AGPL flag. Only maintained STS-like on the web; engine/UI separation documented.

name: open-duelyst/duelyst
embed_notes: Requires Node API server, Redis, Postgres, Firebase realtime DB (Docker compose + Terraform). Heavy.
reskin_notes: Thousands of CC0 sprites/animations; card data JSON; feasible to rebrand UI but not to re-art hundreds of units.
score_hook: Match result/ranked ladder on server; client GameSession events.
notes: Entire commercial CCG released CC0 - biggest permissively-licensed card battler anywhere; infra-heavy.

name: FreezingMoon/AncientBeast
embed_notes: webpack build to static; hotseat and vs-AI run fully client-side; online play via optional server.
reskin_notes: Dozens of hand-drawn creatures + abilities in data; UI/branding easy, unit art hard. Name/logo trademarked.
score_hook: Game end computes score/stats per player (Game.endGame / score board) - reuse.
notes: AGPL flag; mature and active; already runs on Reddit Devvit.

name: doublespeakgames/adarkroom
embed_notes: index.html + script/; no build; localStorage saves.
reskin_notes: All strings in lang/*.json (i18n) and CSS themes; no sprites - rename world/items freely.
score_hook: Engine has score/prestige calc on ending and $SM state machine events (Engine.event) - easy.
notes: Most-starred open-source browser game in this slice; text-only so mascot reskin = copy + CSS.

name: candybox2/candybox2.github.io
embed_notes: Compiled JS committed; open index.html.
reskin_notes: ASCII art in ascii/ and text/ folders; all visuals are text - easy swaps.
score_hook: Candies/lollipops counters in global state; quest completions - hook Saving/Quest classes.
notes: License is a bespoke file (check before commercial use).

name: okaybenji/text-engine
embed_notes: index.html + index.js + game-disks/*.js; no build.
reskin_notes: Whole game is a JSON-ish 'disk' object (rooms, items, text); CSS themes - sponsor story in an afternoon.
score_hook: Disk supports onUse/onLook JS hooks; add score/complete callbacks trivially.
notes: MULTI-GAME (3 disks). GPL flag but the disks you write are yours.

name: nroutasuo/level13
embed_notes: index.html + src/; no build; localStorage saves.
reskin_notes: Text in strings/ + messages.json; minimal img/ icons; CSS themes.
score_hook: Game state (levels reached, milestones) via ECS systems; GameGlobals events hookable.
notes: Apache-2.0 and actively developed ADR-style adventure.

name: mgechev/mk.js
embed_notes: game/ folder is static; server/ only for networked mode.
reskin_notes: Each fighter is a folder of PNG frames + JSON move definitions; arenas as images - swap folders. Midway sprites must be replaced.
score_hook: Fighter life values + fight end callbacks (mk.start options: fighters, callbacks) - easy.
notes: NO LICENSE - flag. Most-starred JS fighting game; chriscourses/fighting-game (375, also unlicensed) is a simpler canvas alternative.

name: chriscourses/fighting-game
embed_notes: index.html + js; no build.
reskin_notes: img/ holds two fighters' sprite sheets and background; ~300 lines of logic.
score_hook: Health bars + timer + determineWinner() - one-line hook.
notes: NO LICENSE (tutorial code) - flag; itch.io free assets (Oak Woods / Martial Hero).

name: kenamick/game-off-2017
embed_notes: webpack build; assets via Git LFS (pull LFS before build).
reskin_notes: 4-color Game Boy palette sprites in src/assets; enemies/levels in JS config.
score_hook: Player HP/level progression; add hook on level complete / game over state.
notes: Only licensed, complete browser beat-'em-up found.

name: hardmaru/neuralslimevolley
embed_notes: index.html + slimevolley.js; no build.
reskin_notes: Slimes are drawn semicircles - recolor trivially; replace drawSlime() with mascot sprite.
score_hook: Match score arrays and game-end in slimevolley.js - easy.
notes: NO LICENSE - flag. Includes trained AI opponent; malgorithms/tippycoco (32, MIT, 2026) is a licensed Slime-Volleyball-like alternative.

name: henshmi/Classic-8-Ball-Pool
embed_notes: dist/ prebuilt and committed; iframe dist/index.html.
reskin_notes: Table/balls/cue sprites in assets; menu labels in code.
score_hook: Game state machine with winner determination - hook GameWorld end.
notes: Small but complete pool game with AI; MIT.

name: Priler/dino3d
embed_notes: index.html/low.html + js + textures; gulp only for minify.
reskin_notes: Voxel models in objects/ + textures/; swap dino model for mascot voxel model.
score_hook: score counter + game over handler in js/game - trivial.
notes: GPL flag. Endless runner with score already; mobile-friendly.

name: EvanBacon/Expo-Crossy-Road
embed_notes: expo export --platform web -> static bundle (bun/npm).
reskin_notes: MagicaVoxel models in assets/models (chicken + vehicles); colors/text in src.
score_hook: Score state in game store, gameOver flag - easy postMessage.
notes: Well-known MIT Crossy Road; heavy toolchain but proven web build.

name: wanfungchui/Boxy-Run
embed_notes: index.html + js/ + style.css; no build.
reskin_notes: Character built from colored boxes in code - recolor to mascot palette instantly; trees procedural.
score_hook: score/gameOver variables in js/game.js - trivial.
notes: Low stars but the cleanest licensed Temple-Run-like; single file game logic.

name: BKcore/HexGL
embed_notes: index.html static (CoffeeScript precompiled to launch.js).
reskin_notes: Ship model + textures in textures/ and geometries/; HUD images.
score_hook: Lap time / race finish in bkcore.hexgl.Gameplay (onFinish) - easy.
notes: Racing may overlap another slice; included as the best-known MIT 3D web game.

name: fenomas/noa
embed_notes: Engine + demo projects (noa-examples); bundle with webpack/vite to static.
reskin_notes: Block textures/atlas and entity meshes supplied by the game; engine used by Mojang's Minecraft Classic web release.
score_hook: None built in (sandbox); add your own objectives.
notes: The engine behind Minecraft Classic in-browser; needs a game layer on top.

name: Overv/WebCraft
embed_notes: singleplayer.html is fully static; multiplayer.html needs node server.js.
reskin_notes: media/terrain.png texture atlas + player skin PNG; block table in js/blocks.js.
score_hook: None (sandbox) - would need blocks-placed/time objectives.
notes: Tiny dependency-free Minecraft clone; permissive Zlib.

name: ill-inc/biomes-game
embed_notes: Very heavy: Next.js app, Redis, Firestore/Bikkie, Rust WASM builds; Docker/dev scripts. Not iframe-drop-in.
reskin_notes: Large original asset pipeline (voxel + 3D); data-driven items ('Bikkie').
score_hook: Player inventory/achievements on server.
notes: Flagged as 'bigger open-source browser game' - MIT shutdown title, infra-heavy.

name: cloudflare/doom-wasm
embed_notes: emscripten build produces static .wasm/.js; ship with freedoom WAD (BSD) or shareware WAD.
reskin_notes: Reskin = WAD modding (sprites/textures/levels) - well-understood but tooling-heavy; UI page is plain HTML.
score_hook: No JS-exposed score; would need to export kills/items/level-end from C via EM_ASM.
notes: GPL flag. Reference Doom-in-browser; alternatives: jacobenget/doom.wasm (9 stars), GMH-Code/Dwasm. js-dos (1322, GPL emulator) can also run shareware Doom.

name: inolen/quakejs
license: NONE in repo (ioquake3 core is GPL-2.0)
embed_notes: Needs node content server + game server for MP; single-player vs bots works once assets served.
reskin_notes: pk3 modding only.
score_hook: Frags via engine console - not JS-friendly.
notes: Flag: no explicit license file; alternatives Triang3l/WebQuake (653, Quake 1, static client) and lrusso/Quake3 (104, pure JS ES5, static with DEMO.pk3).

name: gorescript/gorescript
games: Gorescript Classic (retro FPS, 9 levels + custom maps)
embed_notes: dist/ is static; gulp to rebuild.
reskin_notes: Pixel textures/sprites in app-media; custom map editor format; original (non-id) assets.
score_hook: Level-end stats (kills, secrets, time) already computed - hook GS.Game.onLevelComplete.
notes: Best MIT original-IP browser FPS; unmaintained but complete (Steam release existed).

name: WarsWorld/WarsWorld
embed_notes: Next.js server + Postgres; Docker/railway configs.
reskin_notes: Unit/terrain sprites in public/ (AW-derived - replace); unit data in TS.
score_hook: Match outcome persisted server-side.
notes: AGPL flag; ctomni231/cwtactics (76, MPL-2.0, static, mod system) is the static single-player Advance-Wars engine option.

name: ctomni231/cwtactics
embed_notes: index.html + engine + image; localServer.js only for convenience.
reskin_notes: image/ sprite sheets; mod/ folder is an explicit mod system for units/terrain data.
score_hook: Turn/victory conditions in engine; hook game end.
notes: Long-running MPL Advance-Wars-like, still updated; AW-style art must be replaced.

name: ricardo-foundry/canvas-vampire-survivors
embed_notes: Open index.html; PWA; GH Pages build from main.
reskin_notes: Canvas-drawn shapes/sprites in JS; weapons/enemies as data tables.
score_hook: Survival time / kills / level in game state; game-over screen - easy.
notes: SURPRISE: no Vampire-Survivors-like JS repo with >=25 stars exists on GitHub (all VS clones with stars are Unity/Godot/C). This is the most complete web one; near-zero stars, license needs checking. tiny-ai-ops/Survivors-Like (1 star, MIT) is the licensed fallback.
